_doc: SYNTHETIC fixture test of the frozen E1 v2 assessor; not real evidence; tests interpretation of controlled text only.

fixtures.label: insufficient_evidence

context_evidence.quote: SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE - fictional company, not a real document.
Because consumer demand strengthened markedly during the quarter, the company raised its full-year earnings per share guidance to $4.10-$4.30 from $3.80-$4.00.

fixtures.explanation: The excerpt's wording matches the supported pattern: it ties raised guidance to stronger demand. However, it labels itself a "fictional company, not a real document", so it isn't real evidence that US firms were doing this before the decision time. I treat it as non-evidential context. It is also pre-release context, not a reaction to the retail-sales surprise.
fixtures.note: evidence_type tags are model-assigned; code verifies quotes, not the semantics of the tags

fixtures.label: contradicted

contradicting_evidence.quote: consumer demand for its products was stronger than planned in the quarter. However, the company kept its full-year earnings guidance unchanged at $2.00-$2.10 per share
higher ingredient and wage costs compressed operating margins and offset the benefit of stronger demand.

fixtures.explanation: This pre-release context excerpt says demand was stronger than planned, yet full-year guidance was kept unchanged, so stronger demand did not improve the outlook. It also states the offsetting mechanism: higher ingredient and wage costs compressing margins. Both contradiction criteria are met. The excerpt is a synthetic fixture.

fixtures.label: insufficient_evidence

context_evidence.quote: Example Apparel Co. reported second-quarter revenue of $1.2 billion, up 9% from the prior year.
The company reaffirmed its full-year earnings guidance of $1.50-$1.60 per share.

fixtures.explanation: The excerpt is a pre-release context document. It shows realised revenue growth of 9% and reaffirmed guidance, but it doesn't attribute either to consumer demand. It shows no improved outlook and no offsetting mechanism. Realised results alone and unchanged guidance without a demand link are insufficient for this edge.}
